m: प्रति-√ हा P. -जहाति, to leave unheeded, neglect, Hariv. : Pass. -हीयते, to stay behind (abl.), be defeated, MBh.

प्रति-˚हान (?) cf. next.
प्रति-˚हाराय Nom. to act as door-keeper (˚यितम् impers.), Prasannar.

m: प्रति-हार m. striking against, touch, contact (esp. of the tongue with the teeth in the pronunciation of the dentals), RPrāt.
shutting, closing, stopping (अ-प्र्˚), TāṇḍBr.
N. of partic. syllables in the Sāman hymns (with which the Pratihartṛ begins to join in singing, generally at the beginning of the last Pada of a stanza; also प्रती-ह्˚, AV.; ŚāṅkhBr.), Br.; ŚrS. &c.
N. of a partic. magical formula spoken over weapons, R. (v.l. ˚र-तर)
(that which keeps back), a door, gate (also प्रती-ह्˚, L.; cf. comp. below)
a door-keeper, porter, Hariv.; Kāv.; Pur. &c. (also प्रती-ह्˚; du. two d˚-k˚ i.e. two statues at the entrance of a temple, VarBṛS.; f(ई). a female d˚-k˚, portress, Priyad.)
a juggler, L.
juggling, trick, disguise, L.
a: प्रति(ती)हारः — 1 Striking back. --2 A door, gate. --3 A porter, doorkeeper. --4 A juggler. --5 Juggling, a juggling trick. --6 (In gram.) The hard contact of the tongue with the edge of the teeth in pronouncing dental letters. --री A female doorkeeper. --Comp. --भूमिः f. the threshold (of a house &c.); Ku. 3. 58. --रक्षी a female doorkeeper; R. 6. 20.

m: प्रति-हार—भूमि f. ‘d˚-place’, a threshold, Kum.
the office of a porter or a portress, Ragh.

a: प्रतिहारणं — Entrance, permission to enter a door.

m: प्रति-हार—गोप्त्री f. a female door-keeper, Vcar.

N. of an Avadāna.

m: प्रति-हास m. (√ हस्) returning a laugh, laughing with or at, W.
fragrant oleander, Nerium Odorum, L.

m: प्रति-√ हन् P. -हन्ति (ep. also Ā. pf. -जघ्ने), to beat against (gen.), TāṇḍBr.; to attack, assail, MBh.; to strike down, ib.; to crush, break, RV.; to put on a spit, ib. i, 32, 12; to strike in return, strike back, ward off remove, dispel, check, prevent, frustrate, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; (with आज्ञाम्), to disregard a command, Śiś. : Pass. -हन्यते, to be beaten back &c., MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to be kept away from or deprived of (abl.), Śaṃk. : Caus. -घातयति See under प्रति-घ.
a: प्रतिहन् — {c2c} P. 1 To strike back or in return; (तं) विध्यंतमुद्धृतसटाः प्रतिहंतुमीषुः R. 9. 60. --2 To ward off, keep off, prevent, oppose, resist; तोयस्येवाप्रतिहतरयः सैकतं सेतुमोघः U. 3. 36; प्रतिहतविघ्नाः क्रियाः सभवलोक्य Ś. 1. 13; Me. 20; Ku. 2. 48; V. 2. 1. --3 To repel, drive back, repulse. --4 To remove, destroy; यद्यत्पापं प्रतिजहि जगन्नाथ नम्रस्य तन्मे Māl. 1. 3. --5 To counter-act, remedy. --6 To disown, disavow.

m: प्रति-˚हनन n. impeding, suppressing, Yogas., Sch.
striking again, returning a blow, W.
a: प्रतिहननं — Striking or knocking back, returning a blow.

m: प्रति-˚हन्तव्य mfn. to be opposed or resisted, MBh.; Hariv.
प्रति-˚हन्तृ m. one who wards off, preventer, Ragh. (v.l. ˚हर्तृ).

v: pu॰ prati + hf--ADAre ap । samIpe f॰ 7 । 66 । 14

avoiding, shunning, L.

m: प्रति-˚हर्तृ m. (cf. प्रती-ह्˚) one who draws back or absorbs, a destroyer, MBh.
one who keeps or wards off, an averter, Ragh.
N. of one of the 16 priests (the assistant of the Udgātṛ), Br.; ŚrS. &c.
N. of a king (son of Pratihāra or of Pratīha), Pur.
a: प्रतिहर्तृ — m. 1 One who beats back or removes, repeller, remover, averter, destroyer &c. --2 The assistant of the Udgātṛ q. v.

repelled, warded off, checked, impeded, obstructed, prevented, omitted, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
dazzled (as eyes i.e. impeded in their functions), BhP.
dulled, blunted (as teeth by acids = हृषित), L. (cf. Pat. on Pāṇ. vii, 2, 29)
hostile (cf. below)
disappointed, L.
